title: [3.0-beta3] error importing NS profiles (worked in beta2)
body:
error importing NS profiles. 
right after installing beta3 (I came from beta2) below error popped up.

It is referring to the BG target that has a value of 5.6 in nightscout.
As a result profiles are not imported.

attached logfile. Error is at line:
10:55:09.896 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-2] D/NOTIFICATION: [NotificationStore.add():61]: Notification received: Invalid profile dana_mix_95RES not accepted from NS
![Screenshot_20211104-105518](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28272471/140295927-6aa25823-8d73-432a-aff3-0f608957e505.jpg)
![Screenshot_20211104-105526](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28272471/140295934-914da0dc-55ff-4a8b-9571-835dc97442ad.jpg)
